human_or_authorized_source.rule: Human authority and/or existing authorized source enters through ABBA command/intelligence boundary; capability does not imply authority.

abba.cannot: self-issue authority, replace Canon, or create parallel universal primitives

abba_mas.cannot: be a second master intelligence, constitution, identity system, or universal ledger

shared_capability_fabric.role: semantic capability discovery and contract routing

products.rule: Products are terminal projections/leaves; they consume the shared fabric and do not redefine universal semantics.

providers.rule: Providers are replaceable external implementations reached through capability adapters. Provider availability never creates constitutional authority.

legacy.carbonactual/omnii: archived-provenance; former operating-spine material mapped into Carbon Actual; BUNK extracted

invariants: semantic authority is one Carbon Actual spine
constitutional authority remains HAPI World CANON.md
ABBA is the master intelligence/orchestration layer
authority is explicitly evaluated before consequential execution
